incidents.title: Charcoal Typhoon used ChatGPT for research, scripting and phishing content
incidents.outcome: OpenAI accounts disabled in coordination with Microsoft.
incidents.confidenceReason: OpenAI and Microsoft both state the accounts were tied to this actor; activity was limited, non-novel assistance.
incidents.summary: The China-affiliated group used ChatGPT to research companies and security tools, debug code and generate scripts, and write likely phishing content.
incidents.quote: Charcoal Typhoon used our services to research various companies and cybersecurity tools, debug code and generate scripts, and create content likely for use in phishing campaigns.

harness.note: AI used as a chatbot/assistant, no agent harness
